dailytalk.name: DailyTalk
dailytalk.scope: Full corpus retained and adopted: 2,541 performed dyadic dialogues, all 23,773 original WAV/TXT pairs, original metadata, pinned ECSS supplemental labels and audited ordered indexes. Restoration does not sample or restrict audio to a pilot/evaluation subset; main-project evaluation splits are selected independently.
dailytalk.licence: DailyTalk audio/data CC BY-SA 4.0; ECSS supplemental files retain their upstream MIT notice. Code MIT does not relicense the audio.

emotiontalk.name: EmotionTalk
emotiontalk.scope: Full official audio corpus retained and adopted: all 19,250 original WAV/JSON pairs, 23.6025 hours, 742 published dialogue IDs (734 with both speakers), audio-specific emotion labels and audited timestamp-ordered history indexes. Restoration does not sample or restrict audio to a pilot/evaluation subset; main-project evaluation splits are selected independently.
emotiontalk.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; upstream attribution, license and local change notices preserved. Official free HF automatic gate currently shows no additional redistribution restrictions.

multidialog.name: MultiDialog (retained test splits; baseline pending)
multidialog.scope: Official test_freq/test_rare:18141 original WAVs,831 dialogues,32.3997h. Default complete gold-actor-pair+dialogue QC cohort:7672 clips/353 dialogues/13.0958h; context7319. All source recordings retained; intended script labels, not listener consensus; baseline pending.
multidialog.licence: CC BY-NC4.0 for audio/data and added indexes, with attribution/source/change notices. Official upstream Python loader code notices retained separately; legacy loader Apache string does not relicense the audio. Public ungated free download.
